title: Polish parliament liberalises abortion law – but conservative president likely to veto changes
lede: The Polish governing coalition voted in parliament to loosen abortion law on Tuesday - but conservative president is expected to block the change.

title: Serbia’s election: can a student-led movement of hope overcome Vučić’s hollowed-out political system?
lede: Sunday’s vote could reshape the country’s political future. But even a breakthrough for the student movement would leave a deeper question: can democratic change take root in institutions that protesters say have been hollowed out?
